description: This file implements the GLES1State class, which manages and tracks the state for GLES1 contexts, including matrix stacks, rendering parameters, and various OpenGL states.

classes.name: GLES1State
classes.description: Manages the OpenGL ES 1.x state machine, including matrices, enabled arrays, and rendering parameters.

classes.name: TextureCoordF
classes.description: Represents texture coordinate with four float components, supporting comparison and default construction.

classes.name: MaterialParameters
classes.description: Holds material properties such as ambient, diffuse, specular, and emissive colors.

classes.name: LightModelParameters
classes.description: Contains parameters for the lighting model, including color and two-sided lighting flag.

classes.name: LightParameters
classes.description: Defines parameters for individual lights, including diffuse and specular components.

classes.name: FogParameters
classes.description: Stores fog configuration such as mode, density, start/end distances, and color.

classes.name: TextureEnvironmentParameters
classes.description: Holds texture environment settings for a texture unit.

classes.name: PointParameters
classes.description: Contains parameters related to point size and related settings.

classes.name: ClipPlaneParameters
classes.description: Represents a clip plane's enabled state and its equation vector.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the GLES1State with context and state, setting default values for all parameters.

methods.name: setAlphaFunc
methods.description: Sets the alpha test function and reference value.

methods.name: setClientTextureUnit
methods.description: Sets the active client texture unit.

methods.name: getClientTextureUnit
methods.description: Returns the current active client texture unit.

methods.name: setCurrentColor
methods.description: Sets the current color used for rendering.

methods.name: getCurrentColor
methods.description: Returns the current color.

methods.name: setCurrentNormal
methods.description: Sets the current normal vector.

methods.name: getCurrentNormal
methods.description: Returns the current normal vector.

methods.name: setCurrentTextureCoords
methods.description: Sets the current texture coordinates for a specified unit.

methods.name: getCurrentTextureCoords
methods.description: Returns the current texture coordinates for a specified unit.

methods.name: setMatrixMode
methods.description: Sets the current matrix mode (modelview, projection, texture).

methods.name: getMatrixMode
methods.description: Returns the current matrix mode.

methods.name: getCurrentMatrixStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the specified matrix stack.

methods.name: pushMatrix
methods.description: Pushes the current matrix onto the stack.

methods.name: popMatrix
methods.description: Pops the top matrix from the stack.

methods.name: loadMatrix
methods.description: Loads a new matrix into the current matrix stack.

methods.name: multMatrix
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by the given matrix.

methods.name: setLogicOp
methods.description: Sets the logical operation for pixel operations.

methods.name: setClientStateEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables client-side vertex attribute arrays.

methods.name: setTexCoordArrayEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables texture coordinate arrays for a specific unit.

methods.name: isClientStateEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific client state is enabled.

methods.name: isTexCoordArrayEnabled
methods.description: Checks if texture coordinate array for a unit is enabled.

methods.name: isTextureTargetEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a texture target is enabled for a specific unit.

methods.name: lightModelParameters
methods.description: Returns the light model parameters.

methods.name: lightParameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for a specific light.

methods.name: materialParameters
methods.description: Returns material parameters.

methods.name: isColorMaterialEnabled
methods.description: Checks if color material mode is enabled.

methods.name: setShadeModel
methods.description: Sets the shading model (smooth or flat).

methods.name: setClipPlane
methods.description: Sets the equation for a clip plane.

methods.name: getClipPlane
methods.description: Retrieves the equation of a clip plane.

methods.name: fogParameters
methods.description: Returns fog parameters.

methods.name: textureEnvironment
methods.description: Returns texture environment parameters for a unit.

methods.name: pointParameters
methods.description: Returns point parameters.

methods.name: getVertexArraysAttributeMask
methods.description: Returns a mask of enabled vertex array attributes.

methods.name: getActiveAttributesMask
methods.description: Returns a mask of active attributes (always 8).

methods.name: setHint
methods.description: Sets various hint settings for quality vs performance.

methods.name: getHint
methods.description: Retrieves the current hint setting for a target.

methods.name: setDirty
methods.description: Marks a specific state as dirty for later update.

methods.name: setAllDirty
methods.description: Marks all state bits as dirty.

methods.name: clearDirty
methods.description: Clears all dirty bits.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if a specific state is marked as dirty.
